claims.statement: The assurance kernel constructs the electromagnetic field tensor, stress-energy tensor, four-current, Lorentz four-force density, particle four-momentum, Lorentz boosts, and total four-momentum ledgers in SI units with the declared -+++ metric convention.
nonclaims: This special-relativistic layer is not a nonlinear Einstein-equation solver.
Tensor covariance does not establish physical completeness of a plasma interaction model.

claims.statement: Deterministic bounded tests require electromagnetic scalar invariance, field-tensor covariance, stress-energy covariance, four-force covariance, dominant-energy bounds, mass-shell closure, inverse-boost recovery, null plane-wave structure, and fail-closed four-momentum accounting.
nonclaims: Finite samples are not a universal proof for all fields and boosts.
Passing tests do not establish plasma-wing thrust or net energy extraction.

claims.statement: Connect the covariant field-plus-matter ledger directly to every self-consistent electromagnetic PIC step and to control-volume boundary fluxes.
required_evidence: particle and field four-momentum from the same timestep
grid, timestep, particle-count, and domain refinement
